en:
Atua, huh...
Well, I guess I could use a god...

But I don't want to live here forever.
There's no way this place could be paradise.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

I am looking forward to the magic show
a little bit, though.

Maybe...for a brief moment, I might be 
able to have some fun here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I spent some time imagining
what magic trick Himiko was going to perform.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
